verdict.rationale: Docs show a generic multi-target cook/package/deploy pipeline (-targetplatform=<Plat1>+<Plat2>, packaging to platform-native formats, command-line build automation) that clearly supports building the same project for desktop and mobile from one codebase, and the licensing page references 'All platforms & features' implying console availability under Epic's platform partner program. However, the evidence never explicitly names console platforms (PlayStation/Xbox/Switch) or details the NDA/partner-access process for console SDKs, so console export is only implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit console platform documentation/partner-program details, and independent/hands-on confirmation of a single project shipping across desktop, mobile, and console.
